item.title: 英伟达员工呼吁董事会请回黄仁勋，内网帖收到逾 1600 条评论
item.guid: 英伟达员工呼吁董事会请回黄仁勋，内网帖收到逾-1600-条评论
item.description:
According to internal communications reviewed by "Wired," a senior Nvidia engineer posted on the company's intranet "suggestion box" before Jensen Huang's resignation, requesting the board to first listen to employee opinions. At the time of the report's publication, the post had over 1600 comments, with most supporting Huang's reinstatement. Other employees also sent company-wide emails demanding the board explain the circumstances of his departure. 据《连线》查阅的内部通信，一位英伟达资深工程师在黄仁勋辞职前通过公司内网「建议箱」发帖，要求董事会先听取员工意见。报道发布时，帖子已有逾 1600 条评论，多数支持黄仁勋复职。还有员工向全公司发邮件，要求董事会解释他的离职经过。

Nvidia had previously announced that CFO Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO, and director Harvey Jones would become chairman of the board. The board is currently selecting a permanent CEO from both inside and outside the company. "Wired" sought confirmation from Nvidia and Jones regarding the employees' appeal, but had not received a response at the time of publication. 英伟达此前已宣布由首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯担任临时 CEO，董事哈维·琼斯出任董事会主席。董事会正从公司内外遴选正式 CEO。《连线》就员工的呼吁向英伟达和琼斯求证，报道刊发时尚未收到回应。

Before the news of the leadership change was announced, some netizens on X suggested that Elon Musk hire Jensen Huang, to which Musk replied, "That would be my honor." On the 13th, he also reposted a conversation clip about Jensen Huang published by a16z, with only one word: "Jensen." 换帅消息公布前，有网友在 X 上建议马斯克聘用黄仁勋，马斯克回应「那将是我的荣幸」。13 日，他又转发了 a16z 发布的一段有关黄仁勋的对谈片段，只配了一个词「Jensen」。

On November 13, Eastern Time, Nvidia closed at $162.85 per share, down 2.01%, and had fallen to $158.39 during intraday trading. The company's market capitalization was approximately $3.92 trillion, surpassing Microsoft again at closing to rank second in U.S. stocks, trailing only Apple's approximately $5.18 trillion. 美东时间 11 月 13 日，英伟达收报每股 162.85 美元，下跌 2.01%，盘中一度跌至 158.39 美元。公司市值约为 3.92 万亿美元，收盘时重新超越微软，位居美股第二，仅次于苹果的约 5.18 万亿美元。

Nvidia's stock fell 12.7% this week, with its market value evaporating over $573 billion, marking its sixth consecutive week of decline and its longest losing streak since 2012. 英伟达本周累计下跌 12.7%，市值蒸发超过 5730 亿美元，连续第六周下跌，创下 2012 年以来最长连跌纪录。

🔗 Related Reading (APPSO): Jensen Huang jokingly calls himself "scum," Nvidia employees collectively call for his return 🔗 相关阅读（APPSO）： 黄仁勋自嘲是「人渣」，英伟达员工集体喊话求回归

item.title: 余承东和张兴海同台发布问界新 M8，重申华为与赛力斯分工
item.guid: 余承东和张兴海同台发布问界新-M8，重申华为与赛力斯分工
item.description:
The AITO new M8 was launched on November 13 at the Seres Super Factory in Chongqing. Huawei Consumer BG Chairman Richard Yu and Seres Group Chairman Zhang Xinghai attended the event together. Yu Chengdong stated that Seres participates in Huawei-led work, and Huawei also participates in Seres-led work. 问界新 M8 于 11 月 13 日在重庆赛力斯超级工厂上市。华为终端 BG 董事长余承东与赛力斯集团董事长张兴海同台出席。余承东说，华为主导的工作有赛力斯参与，赛力斯主导的工作也有华为参与。

According to现场报道 by Bianews, Richard Yu introduced at the conference that Huawei is responsible for the new M8's core technology, product definition, and design, while Seres is responsible for engineering implementation, vehicle manufacturing, and sales services. The two parties signed a new five-year cooperation agreement in September, and AITO remains within the HarmonyOS Smart Travel ecosystem, with a dedicated team established for its operation. 据鞭牛士现场报道，余承东在会上介绍，华为负责新 M8 的核心技术、产品定义和设计，赛力斯负责工程落地、整车制造及销售服务。双方在 9 月签署了新的五年合作协议，问界仍在鸿蒙智行体系内，并组建专属团队运营。

The new M8 offers two power options: extended-range and pure electric, each available in five-seat and six-seat configurations. The new car is equipped with Huawei Qiankun Smart Driving ADS 5, and all models feature an 800V platform and dual-chamber closed air suspension. The extended-range version announced at the press conference has a maximum CLTC comprehensive range of 1385 kilometers, while the pure electric version has a maximum CLTC range of 800 kilometers. 新 M8 有增程和纯电两种动力，各提供五座和六座布局。新车搭载华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5，全系配备 800V 平台和双腔闭式空气悬架。发布会公布的增程版 CLTC 综合续航最高 1385 公里，纯电版 CLTC 续航最高 800 公里。

🔗 Related Reading: Richard Yu announces Huawei AITO's new cooperation model! New M8 simultaneously launched, starting price 379,800 yuan 🔗 相关阅读： 余承东公布华为问界新合作模式！新 M8 同步上市，起售价 37.98 万元

item.title: DeepSeek 开放 App 工具接口，开发者可接入搜索、文件和语音
item.guid: DeepSeek-开放-App-工具接口，开发者可接入搜索、文件和语音
item.description:
On November 13, DeepSeek opened a set of application APIs, integrating tools such as internet search, file input, and link reading used by its official app and web interface into existing dialogue interfaces. After developers enable the corresponding tools in the V4.1-Flash Messages, Responses, or Chat Completions interfaces, the server will process the tool calls and return the results to the dialogue context. DeepSeek 11 月 13 日开放一组应用 API，把官方 App 和网页端使用的联网搜索、文件输入、链接阅读等工具接入现有对话接口。开发者在 V4.1-Flash 的 Messages、Responses 或 Chat Completions 接口启用相应工具后，服务端会处理工具调用，并把结果放回对话上下文。

In normal mode, you can search web pages or images by question and include citations in the answer. In thinking mode, you can continue to search and open links in multi-step reasoning. When uploading PDF, Office documents, or images, the interface can extract text or parse mixed text and image content, then hand it over to the model for answering. 普通模式可按问题搜索网页或图片，并在回答中附上引用。思考模式可以在多步推理中继续搜索、打开链接。上传 PDF、Office 文档或图片时，接口可提取文本或解析图文混排内容，再交给模型回答。

Web search and scraping, image text recognition, speech recognition, and speech synthesis can also be called separately. DeepSeek also open-sourced a static chat page to demonstrate attachments, voice, and link reading, and supports importing DeepSeek historical conversations. 网页搜索和抓取、图片文字识别、语音识别及语音合成也可单独调用。DeepSeek 同时开源了一个静态聊天页面，用来演示附件、语音和链接阅读，并支持导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。

🔗 Related Reading: Just now, DeepSeek opened its full suite of APIs, allowing everyone to build their own super app 🔗 相关阅读： 刚刚，DeepSeek 开放全家桶 API，人人都能打造自己的超级 App

item.title: Microsoft 365 故障仍在恢复，微软将邮件超时窗口延长至 48 小时
item.guid: Microsoft-365-故障仍在恢复，微软将邮件超时窗口延长至-48-小时
item.description:
The Microsoft 365 outage extended from November 12 to 13, US local time. In an update on the afternoon of the 13th, Microsoft stated that some infrastructure showed early signs of stabilization, but service capacity had not yet returned to normal. To protect backlogged emails, Microsoft extended the delivery timeout window to 48 hours. Microsoft 365 故障从美国当地时间 11 月 12 日延续至 13 日。微软在 13 日下午的更新中称，部分基础设施已出现早期趋稳迹象，但服务容量尚未恢复正常。为保护积压的邮件，微软将投递超时窗口延长至 48 小时。

Previously, some servers lost responsiveness again after resuming traffic reception. Microsoft applied patches to upstream authentication and routing configuration components, and the engineering team is progressively offloading traffic, restarting, and repairing servers, then bringing them back online in phases. The outage extended from Exchange Online to features relying on email services, involving Outlook email sending/receiving, Teams calendar and meeting scheduling, SharePoint Online, and some functionalities of Microsoft 365 Copilot. 此前，部分服务器恢复接收流量后再次失去响应。微软为上游身份验证和路由配置组件应用了补丁，工程团队正逐批卸下流量、重启和修复服务器，再分阶段接回。故障从 Exchange Online 扩展到依赖邮件服务的功能，涉及 Outlook 邮件收发、Teams 日历和会议安排、SharePoint Online 及 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的部分功能。

Australia's Lachlan Shire Council stated that the outage prevented some state government services from being processed over the counter, though regular payments were still accepted. The Philippine Supreme Court reported that work such as email replies was affected. U.S. commercial vehicle company Workhorse postponed its Q3 earnings call, originally scheduled for the 12th, to the 16th. 澳大利亚上拉克伦郡议会称，故障导致部分州政府业务无法在柜台办理，普通缴费仍可受理。菲律宾最高法院表示，邮件回复等工作受到影响。美国商用车公司 Workhorse 将原定 12 日举行的三季度财报电话会推迟到 16 日。

item.title: OpenAI 撤销独立机器人团队，研究人员并入通用模型团队
item.guid: OpenAI-撤销独立机器人团队，研究人员并入通用模型团队
item.description:
OpenAI confirmed to Fortune that the company has disbanded its independent robotics team. Robotics researchers will be integrated into the research division led by Chief Research Officer Mark Chen, while the robotics application and hardware teams will transfer to the applications division overseen by President Greg Brockman. OpenAI 向《财富》证实，公司已撤销独立机器人团队。机器人研究人员将并入由首席研究官马克·陈领导的研究部门，机器人应用和硬件团队则转入总裁格雷格·布罗克曼负责的应用部门。

OpenAI stated that researchers had planned to advance robotics research along the lines of video generation models like Sora at the beginning of the year, but later discovered that general models like GPT-6 Astra could directly be used to perform some robotic tasks. The company is integrating robotics research into broader model development efforts, with hardware and applications continuing to be handled by another department. OpenAI 表示，研究人员年初曾计划沿着 Sora 等视频生成模型的路线推进机器人研究，随后发现 GPT-6 Astra 等通用模型可以直接用于执行部分机器人任务。公司将机器人研究并入更广泛的模型研发工作，硬件和应用继续由另一部门负责。

item.title: 两部门公布新型储能方案，提出到 2030 年平均储能约 3 小时
item.guid: 两部门公布新型储能方案，提出到-2030-年平均储能约-3-小时
item.description:
The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration publicly released the "15th Five-Year Plan for New Energy Storage Implementation" on November 13, proposing that by 2030, the national installed capacity of new energy storage will reach 300 million kilowatts, with an average storage duration of approximately 3 hours. Among these, the target for grid-side independent new energy storage capable of ensuring supply during peak electricity consumption is approximately 140 million kilowatts. 国家发展改革委、国家能源局 11 月 13 日公开《「十五五」新型储能实施方案》，提出到 2030 年全国新型储能装机达到 3 亿千瓦，平均储能时长约 3 小时。其中，可在用电高峰承担保供任务的电网侧独立新型储能规模目标为约 1.4 亿千瓦。

The plan proposes establishing a capacity pricing mechanism for grid-side independent new energy storage under the premise of list management. After the continuous operation of the spot electricity market, a reliable capacity compensation mechanism will be gradually established. For the demand side, industrial parks and 5G communication base stations are encouraged to configure energy storage according to actual needs. 方案提出，在实行清单管理的前提下，建立电网侧独立新型储能的容量电价机制。电力现货市场连续运行后，有序建立可靠容量补偿机制。用电侧则鼓励产业园区和 5G 通信基站等按实际需求配置储能。

item.title: LangChain 完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值 30 亿美元
item.guid: LangChain-完成-3-亿美元-C-轮融资，估值-30-亿美元
item.description:
AI agent development platform LangChain announced the completion of a $300 million Series C funding round, valuing the company at $3 billion. Existing investor CapitalG led the round, with GIC and DFJ Growth participating for the first time, and existing investors such as IVP and Sapphire Ventures following on. AI 智能体开发平台 LangChain 宣布完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值为 30 亿美元。老股东 CapitalG 领投，GIC、DFJ Growth 首次参投，IVP 和 Sapphire Ventures 等老股东跟投。

LangChain stated that over 7,000 organizations are already using its LangSmith platform. The platform supports deploying agents driven by different models, records model and tool calls in each run, and allows enterprises to uniformly manage tool permissions and model budgets. LangChain claims that Workday used this platform to reduce the time to deploy new agents from five months to less than a day. The company plans to announce new LangSmith features on November 20. LangChain 表示，已有逾 7000 家机构使用其 LangSmith 平台。平台支持部署由不同模型驱动的智能体，记录每次运行中的模型和工具调用，并让企业统一管理工具权限和模型预算。LangChain 称，Workday 用这套平台将部署新智能体的时间从五个月缩短到不到一天。公司计划于 11 月 20 日公布 LangSmith 新功能。

item.title: 💡 灵光产品经理谈个人 AI 助手：团队开始数用户愿意托管多少件事
item.guid: 💡-灵光产品经理谈个人-AI-助手：团队开始数用户愿意托管多少件事
item.description:
Ant Group's AI application, Lingguang, launched its 2.0 version in late October. Lingguang product manager Siji recently told "LatePost" that the team considers "hosting volume" as the core metric for personal AI assistants, counting the number of ongoing tasks users entrust to the application. 蚂蚁集团旗下 AI 应用灵光在 10 月底上线 2.0 版。灵光产品经理寺二近日接受《晚点》采访时说，团队把「托管量」作为衡量个人 AI 助手的核心指标，统计用户交给应用持续跟进的事项。

Siji gave an example: ordering a cup of coffee is a single task, but continuously monitoring flight prices is a hosted affair. The application runs continuously in the cloud, actively reminding the user when prices change or a decision is needed. The team also observes whether users return after a reminder is sent and if they are willing to provide more information to let the assistant continue with the task. 寺二举例，点一杯咖啡是一次任务，持续盯着机票价格才是一项托管事务。应用在云端持续运行，在价格变动或需要用户作决定时主动提醒。团队也会看提醒发出后用户是否回来，以及用户是否愿意继续补充情况，让助手把事情往下办。

Siji said that current hosting is more focused on monitoring and reminding. To enable the assistant to perform actual operations further, data and interfaces across different internet platforms still need to be integrated. 寺二说，目前的托管更多集中在监测和提醒。要让助手进一步完成实际操作，还要打通不同互联网平台的数据和接口。

item.title: 荣耀 700 系列定档 11 月 23 日，背屏可贴 GIF、看通知
item.guid: 荣耀-700-系列定档-11-月-23-日，背屏可贴-GIF、看通知
item.description:
Honor announced that the Honor 700 series launch event is scheduled for November 23 at 14:30, with singer and actress Ju Jingyi serving as the series ambassador. Reservations for the series are now open. 荣耀宣布，荣耀 700 系列发布会定于 11 月 23 日 14:30，歌手、演员鞠婧祎担任该系列代言人。系列目前已开放预约。

Honor revealed several ways to interact with the rear screen: dragging emojis, GIFs, or static images to the rear screen, checking notifications by raising the hand, and playing mini-games on the rear screen. Official pre-release promotions also mentioned a Snapdragon chip, a 9000mAh Qinghai Lake battery, and 4K dynamic photos. 荣耀公布了背屏的几项玩法：把表情包、GIF 或静态图片拖到背屏，抬手查看通知，以及在背屏上玩小游戏。官方预热还提到骁龙芯片、9000mAh 青海湖电池和 4K 动态照片。

item.title: 东风日产 NX7 亮相，车内展示可拆卸磁吸垃圾桶
item.guid: 东风日产-NX7-亮相，车内展示可拆卸磁吸垃圾桶
item.description:
Dongfeng Nissan showcased the plug-in hybrid SUV NX7 at the Zhuhai NISSAN DAY on November 13. A magnetic car trash can was displayed at the press conference. A demo image on the large screen showed it placed in a fixed position inside the car, which could be directly removed for cleaning. 东风日产在 11 月 13 日的珠海 NISSAN DAY 上展示了插电混动 SUV NX7。发布会现场展示了一款车载磁吸垃圾桶。会场大屏上的演示图把它放在车内的固定位置，清理时可以直接取下。

The NX7 belongs to Nissan's new energy N series developed in China. Nissan listed it as a global debut model for the day in its event preview; previously, this series had launched the pure electric sedan N7 and the new energy SUV NX8. NX7 属于日产在中国开发的新能源 N 序列。日产在活动预告中把它列为当天全球首秀的车型，此前这一序列已推出纯电轿车 N7 和新能源 SUV NX8。

item.title: 索尼新一代 Walkman 开启国行预售，ZX900 售 10999 元
item.guid: 索尼新一代-Walkman-开启国行预售，ZX900-售-10999-元
item.description:
Sony's official Jingdong flagship store has listed the new generation Signature Series Walkman. The three models are NW-WM1ZM3, NW-WM1AM3, and NW-ZX900. The Jingdong product page shows that the pre-sale price for the NW-ZX900 is 10,999 yuan, with the deposit phase ending at noon on November 15, and final payment starting at 12:30 on the same day. 索尼京东自营旗舰店已上架新一代醇音系列 Walkman。三款机型分别是 NW-WM1ZM3、NW-WM1AM3 和 NW-ZX900。京东商品页显示，NW-ZX900 预售价为 10999 元，11 月 15 日中午结束定金阶段，当天 12:30 开始付尾款。

All three devices are equipped with Android 16 and support aptX Adaptive and LE Audio. Sony has added a feed-forward noise shaper to the digital amplifier. The smaller ZX900 in the series features an aluminum alloy main body paired with a gold-plated oxygen-free copper back cover; Sony's stated battery life of approximately 38 hours corresponds to the native player playing 96kHz/24bit FLAC files via a balanced connection. 三款机器均搭载安卓 16，支持 aptX Adaptive 和 LE Audio。索尼在数字放大器中加入了前瞻式噪声整形器。系列中体积较小的 ZX900 用铝合金主机身搭配镀金无氧铜后盖；索尼给出的约 38 小时续航对应原生播放器通过平衡接口播放 96kHz/24bit FLAC 文件的场景。

item.title: 保时捷 CEO 谈 Mission S：瞄准比 911 更高的市场
item.guid: 保时捷-CEO-谈-Mission-S：瞄准比-911-更高的市场
item.description:
According to Bloomberg, Porsche CEO Michael Leiters spoke about Mission S at an automotive industry conference in Berlin on November 11. He said Porsche wants to demonstrate engineering innovations that consumers can actually feel. He discussed his company's Mission S alongside the Tesla Roadster, believing the two cars target different buyers. 据彭博社报道，保时捷 CEO 迈克尔·莱特斯 11 月 11 日在柏林的一场汽车行业会议上谈到 Mission S。他说，保时捷想展示消费者能实际感受到的工程创新。他把自家的 Mission S 和特斯拉 Roadster 放在一起谈，认为两款车面向不同的买家。

Mission S is a mid-engine concept sports car that Porsche plans to position above the 911. Bloomberg reported that the car's design can accommodate hybrid or internal combustion engine powertrains. Both cars were publicly displayed on October 15, when Tesla demonstrated using compressed gas thrusters to briefly lift the Roadster off the ground. Mission S 是一款中置发动机概念跑车，保时捷计划把它放在 911 之上。彭博社报道，该车的设计可容纳混动或内燃机动力系统。两款车都在 10 月 15 日公开展示，当时特斯拉演示了利用压缩气体推进器让 Roadster 短暂腾空。

item.title: 虾米音乐关停五年后，阿里上线 AI 写歌应用「快乐虾米」
item.guid: 虾米音乐关停五年后，阿里上线-AI-写歌应用「快乐虾米」
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, Alibaba's "Kuaile Xiami" (Happy Shrimp) launched on iOS and Android app stores on November 13. By inputting a story, desired emotion, or specified music style, the app can generate a complete song with lyrics and vocals, and also supports generating instrumental music. 据界面新闻报道，阿里旗下「快乐虾米」11 月 13 日登陆 iOS 和安卓应用商店。输入一段故事、想表达的情绪或指定曲风，应用可以生成带歌词和演唱的完整歌曲，也支持生成纯音乐。

The app has a 'create similar' entry point. When users scroll through the music feed and find a work they like, they can adopt its creative ideas and replace them with their own stories or themes. Jiemian News gives an example: organized chat records can also be used as songwriting material, with the app extracting content to generate lyrics and songs. 应用里有一个「做同款」入口。用户在音乐信息流刷到喜欢的作品时，可以沿用它的创作思路，再换成自己的故事或主题。界面新闻举例，整理后的聊天记录也可以当作写歌素材，由应用提取内容生成歌词和歌曲。

The original Xiami Music ceased service in 2021. 'Happy Xiami' was developed by Alibaba's ATH team, first launching a web beta in August this year, and now bringing creation and sharing entry points to mobile phones. 原来的虾米音乐于 2021 年停止服务。「快乐虾米」由阿里 ATH 团队开发，今年 8 月先推出网页测试版，这次把创作和分享入口带到了手机上。

item.title: 宁德时代发布巧克力电池管家，换电时可查电池健康状况
item.guid: 宁德时代发布巧克力电池管家，换电时可查电池健康状况
item.description:
According to Jiemian News, CATL released its 'Chocolate Battery Butler' on November 13, dividing battery detection between vehicles and battery swap stations. Vehicles can perform 53 self-inspections, while swap stations can conduct 66 in-depth inspections. 据界面新闻报道，宁德时代 11 月 13 日发布「巧克力电池管家」，把电池检测分到车上和换电站。车端可做 53 项自检，换电站可做 66 项深度检测。

CATL promises that batteries within the Chocolate battery swap network will enjoy lifetime monitoring, lifetime warranty, and free repair or replacement. The company plans to build a cumulative total of 6,000 Chocolate battery swap stations by 2027, covering 297 cities. 宁德时代承诺，巧克力换电网络内的在网电池可享终身监测、终身质保和免费维修、更换。公司计划到 2027 年累计建成 6000 座巧克力换电站，覆盖 297 座城市。

item.title: Gemini 接入 Google 钱包，可以整理账单和查找订阅扣款
item.guid: Gemini-接入-Google-钱包，可以整理账单和查找订阅扣款
item.description:
Google has started rolling out Google Wallet connection functionality to Gemini users in the US, covering web, Android, and iOS applications. After users actively enable the connection, they can use '@Google Wallet' in chats to query spending records, or choose to connect bank or credit card accounts to the wallet via Plaid. 谷歌开始向美国 Gemini 用户推送 Google 钱包连接功能，覆盖网页版和 Android、iOS 应用。用户主动开启连接后，可在聊天里用「@Google Wallet」查询消费记录，也可选择通过 Plaid 把银行或信用卡账户接入钱包。

Gemini can generate spending charts based on existing bills, identify recurring debits across accounts and flag price increases, or use last year's travel and gift expenses to help set this year's budget. Connection permissions are limited to reading account data, and users can disconnect at any time in the settings. Gemini 可根据已有账单生成支出图表，找出跨账户的定期扣款并标注涨价项目，或用去年的旅行、礼物开支辅助制定今年预算。连接权限仅限读取账户数据，用户可在设置里随时断开。

item.title: 腾讯混元发布 Hy Realtime，元宝语音通话可以点歌、联网搜索
item.guid: 腾讯混元发布-Hy-Realtime，元宝语音通话可以点歌、联网搜索
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan released its real-time voice model Hy Realtime on November 13, which has been integrated into Yuanbao voice calls and Tencent customer service. After updating to the latest version of Yuanbao, users can select the 'Chuyu' voice for an enhanced experience during voice calls. Tencent Cloud plans to open its API soon. 腾讯混元 11 月 13 日发布实时语音模型 Hy Realtime，已接入元宝语音通话和腾讯客服。更新到最新版元宝后，可在语音通话中选择「初语」音色体验。腾讯云计划近期开放 API。

The new model can determine whether to search online based on context during a call, and can also understand half-spoken sentences or sudden changes in user's speech by combining with previous dialogue. When responding, the model can generate text and synthesize speech simultaneously, reducing the waiting time before speaking. 新模型能在通话中根据上下文判断是否需要联网搜索，也能结合前面的对话理解用户说到一半的句子或临时改口。回答时，模型可以一边生成文字一边合成语音，减少开口前的等待。

The singing capability was jointly developed by Hunyuan and Tencent Music's TME Lingyin AI team. When requesting a song, users can combine singer, genre, language, and release year, for example, asking it to pick and sing an English folk song released between 2010 and 2020. 演唱能力由混元与腾讯音乐 TME 灵音 AI 团队联合开发。点歌时可以组合歌手、曲风、语种和发行年份，比如请它挑一首 2010 年至 2020 年间发行的英文民谣并演唱。

item.title: Thinking Machines 开放 Inkling 2 Small 模型权重，可自行部署
item.guid: Thinking-Machines-开放-Inkling-2-Small-模型权重，可自行部署
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has uploaded the model weights for Inkling 2 Small to Hugging Face, under the Apache 2.0 license. The model was announced on November 5, and with this open download, developers can deploy it in their own environments or call it through platforms like Together and Fireworks. Thinking Machines Lab 将 Inkling 2 Small 的模型权重上传至 Hugging Face，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。该模型于 11 月 5 日公布，这次开放下载后，开发者可在自有环境部署，也可以通过 Together、Fireworks 等平台调用。

Inkling 2 Small is a mixture-of-experts model that supports image input, with a total of 594 billion parameters and 17 billion activated per inference. The model supports adjusting inference input and has been integrated into inference frameworks such as vLLM and SGLang. Inkling 2 Small 是一个支持图像输入的混合专家模型，总参数 5940 亿，每次推理激活 170 亿。模型支持调节推理投入，也已接入 vLLM、SGLang 等推理框架。

item.title: 肯德基员工称备货系统在打烊前派单，要后厨再烤 17 只鸡
item.guid: 肯德基员工称备货系统在打烊前派单，要后厨再烤-17-只鸡
item.description:
According to Sina Finance, several KFC frontline employees stated that after stores began using the EPQC inventory system, the production tasks issued on screens sometimes did not match actual demand. One employee said that their store closes at 11 PM, but the system still requested the kitchen to roast 17 more whole chickens at 9:30 PM. 据新浪财经报道，多位肯德基一线员工称，门店使用 EPQC 备货系统后，屏幕下发的制作任务有时与实际需求不符。一名员工说，所在门店晚上 11 点打烊，系统在晚上 9 点半还要求后厨再烤 17 只全鸡。

In the past, the general distribution position responsible for coordinating meal preparation would check on-site inventory and orders, directly telling the kitchen how much to make. Employees say that the system now assigns orders based on inventory and sales pace; during busy periods, there isn't enough time to correct inventory, which can lead to negative inventory appearing on screen, thereby triggering new production tasks. Some stores have reverted to verbal communication to arrange meal preparation to avoid overstocking. KFC customer service told Sina Finance that the relevant situation needs to be verified by the backend. 过去，负责协调供餐的总配岗位会看现场库存和订单，直接告诉后厨做多少。员工说，系统现在会结合库存和售卖节奏派单，忙时来不及修正库存，屏幕上可能出现负库存，继而触发新的制作任务。部分门店为避免备货过量，已重新用口头沟通安排出餐。肯德基客服向新浪财经表示，相关情况需要后台核实。

item.title: 大疆将从 11 月 18 日起调整部分产品建议零售价
item.guid: 大疆将从-11-月-18-日起调整部分产品建议零售价
item.description:
DJI issued a statement on November 13, announcing that it will adjust the suggested retail prices of some products starting from 0:00 on November 18. DJI attributes this price adjustment to the continuous rise in costs of several key components, such as semiconductors and storage. Which models are affected and what the adjusted prices will be will be displayed on the corresponding product detail pages in the DJI official store. 大疆在 11 月 13 日发布说明，将从 11 月 18 日零时起调整部分产品的建议零售价。大疆把这次调价归因于半导体、存储等多项关键零部件成本持续上涨。涉及哪些型号、调整后的价格是多少，将在 DJI 官方商城对应商品详情页展示。

News of the price adjustment first appeared in some authorized stores. On November 10, Jiemian News inquired with DJI's JD.com official flagship store about the price increase for the Osmo Pocket series, and customer service stated at the time that they had not yet received a price adjustment notice. The statement subsequently issued by DJI for the first time clarified the effective date of the price adjustment for some products. 调价消息最早出现在部分授权门店。11 月 10 日，界面新闻就 Osmo Pocket 系列的涨价消息询问大疆京东自营旗舰店，客服当时表示尚未收到调价通知。大疆随后发出的这份说明，首次明确了部分产品调价的生效时间。

item.title: 星图数据：双 11 电商销售额达 17764 亿元，即时零售增长 33%
item.guid: 星图数据：双-11-电商销售额达-17764-亿元，即时零售增长-33%
item.description:
According to the monitoring report released by Syntun on November 12, this year's Double 11 total e-commerce sales across the entire network reached 1.7764 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 4.8%. This scope covers comprehensive e-commerce, instant retail, and community group buying. Among the three types of channels, instant retail had the highest growth, with sales increasing by 33% year-on-year; comprehensive e-commerce grew by 3.7%, and community group buying declined by 7.4%. 星图数据 11 月 12 日发布的监测报告显示，今年双 11 全网电商销售额达 17764 亿元，同比增长 4.8%。这一口径涵盖综合电商、即时零售和社区团购。三类渠道里，即时零售增幅最高，销售额同比增长 33%；综合电商增长 3.7%，社区团购下滑 7.4%。

During the major promotion, platforms also sold home services. According to Yicai, JD.com generated over 300 million service orders during Double 11. JD.com disclosed that the transaction volume for multi-session home cleaning services increased by over 550% year-on-year, and pet room hair removal services increased by 46 times year-on-year. 大促期间，平台也在卖上门服务。据第一财经报道，京东双 11 期间产生了超 3 亿笔服务订单。京东披露，家政多次卡保洁服务成交额同比增长超过 550%，宠物居室除毛服务同比增长 46 倍。

item.title: One Fun Thing｜用 AirPods 充电盒控制 Mac 光标
item.guid: One-Fun-Thing｜用-AirPods-充电盒控制-Mac-光标
item.description:
The open-source project AirPointer demonstrates a method for operating a Mac. By placing AirPods back into their charging case and closing the lid, rotating the case moves the cursor, and tapping the front of the case acts as a click. The first time it's used, the app will ask the user to point to three dots on the screen sequentially for calibration. 开源项目 AirPointer 演示了一种操作 Mac 的方法。把 AirPods 放回充电盒并合上盖子，转动盒子就能移动光标，轻拍盒子正面则相当于点击。第一次使用时，应用会让用户依次指向屏幕上的三个点来校准。

The app reads the headphones' motion data via Bluetooth and converts it into cursor position. The author tested it with a pair of AirPods Pro 3 and an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26. 应用通过蓝牙读取耳机的运动数据，把它换算成光标的位置。作者用一副 AirPods Pro 3 和一台运行 macOS 26 的 Apple 芯片 Mac 测试。

The connection briefly interrupts headphone audio, and a session ends approximately half an hour after closing the lid. The project page also reminds that ending a session consumes diagnostic data stored in the charging case. 连接会短暂打断耳机音频，一次会话在合盖后约半小时结束。项目页也提醒，结束会话会消耗充电盒中存储的诊断数据。

item.title: 周末看什么｜《海上钢琴师》4K 修复版重回内地影院
item.guid: 周末看什么｜《海上钢琴师》4K-修复版重回内地影院
item.description:
Orphan 1900 grew up on transatlantic cruise ships, never setting foot on land. He learned to play the piano and met successive waves of passengers through his performances. A jazz musician specifically boarded the ship to challenge him, and two pianists engaged in a showdown at the same piano. 孤儿 1900 在往返欧美的邮轮上长大，从未踏上陆地。他学会了弹钢琴，也靠演奏认识一批又一批上船的旅客。一位爵士乐手特意上船挑战他，两个钢琴家在同一架琴前展开较量。

The Legend of 1900 is directed by Giuseppe Tornatore, with Tim Roth starring as 1900, and Ennio Morricone composing the film's score. The 4K restored version was re-released in mainland Chinese cinemas starting November 13. The film received a 9.3 rating on Douban. 《海上钢琴师》由朱塞佩·托纳多雷执导，蒂姆·罗斯饰演 1900，恩尼奥·莫里科内为影片作曲。4K 修复版于 11 月 13 日起在中国内地院线重映。影片在豆瓣获 9.3 分。

item.title: 买书不读指南｜《市场赢家》：一张门票是怎么分到你手里的
item.guid: 买书不读指南｜《市场赢家》：一张门票是怎么分到你手里的
item.description:
Scrambling for concert tickets, waiting on restaurant waitlists, or filling out applications for desired schools—all encounter the same problem: when there are more people who want something than there are available spots, who decides who gets it first? Economist Judd Kessler, in Market Winners , dissects several common allocation methods, including first-come, first-served, queuing, lotteries, and matching based on individual preferences. 抢演唱会门票、排餐厅候补、给想上的学校填志愿，都会遇到同一个问题：当想要的人比名额多，谁来决定先给谁？经济学家贾德·凯斯勒在《市场赢家》里拆解了几种常见的分配办法，包括先到先得、排队、抽签，以及按个人偏好匹配。

The book discusses both how participants make decisions and what costs rule-makers must bear. For instance, when restaurants allocate reservations, first-come, first-served favors those familiar with release times, while waitlists and lotteries each have their own costs. Kessler combines these everyday examples with market design research to discuss how fairness, efficiency, and incentives interact. 书里既谈参与者怎么做决定，也谈规则制定者要付出什么代价。比如餐厅发放订位时，先到先得让熟悉放号时间的人占优，候补和抽签则各有成本。凯斯勒把这些日常例子和市场设计研究放在一起，讨论公平、效率与激励如何相互牵制。

The simplified Chinese edition was translated by Cui Chuangang and published by CITIC Press Group in October 2026. The paperback is available at the CITIC Press self-operated store on JD.com. 简体中文版由崔传刚译，中信出版集团于 2026 年 10 月出版。纸书在京东中信出版社自营店有售。

item.title: 游戏推荐｜《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版
item.guid: 游戏推荐｜《塞尔达传说-时之笛》重制版
item.description:
Upon returning to the Water Temple, Link can quickly equip and unequip the Iron Boots using the D-pad, and then rotate the camera with the right stick to view paths at different water levels. 重回水之神殿时，林克可以用方向键快速穿脱重铁靴，再用右摇杆转动镜头，查看不同水位下的通路。

IGN China gave the Switch 2 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time a perfect 10, particularly praising how independent jumping, dashing, and quick item switching improve exploration in older dungeons. The review also noted that hints for some puzzles are more obvious, and the number of small keys in the Water Temple has been reduced, thereby lowering the puzzle-solving threshold. IGN 中国给 Switch 2 版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》打出 10 分，尤其肯定独立跳跃、冲刺和道具快捷切换对旧迷宫探索的改善。评测也指出，部分谜题的提示更显眼，水之神殿的小钥匙有所减少，解谜门槛随之降低。

Nintendo remade this version based on the 1998 original. Players still travel between the child and adult eras, using items available in each to advance their adventure. The remake updated the environments and orchestral soundtrack, expanded character dialogue, and added voice acting to cutscenes. 任天堂以 1998 年的原作为基础重新制作了这一版。玩家仍要在少年与成年两个时代之间往返，利用各自可用的道具推进冒险。重制版更新了场景和管弦乐配乐，扩写了角色对白，并为过场动画加入配音。

The game was released on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026. Players can also hum melodies Link has learned into the console's microphone, and Link in the game will play them on the Ocarina of Time. 游戏已于 2026 年 11 月 5 日登陆 Nintendo Switch 2。玩家还可以对着主机麦克风哼唱林克学过的旋律，游戏中的林克会用时之笛把它吹出来。

OpenAI 余承东
